same_issue.instructions: A maintainer wrote reviewer_comment on this change; an automated reviewer wrote agent_finding about the same change. Does agent_finding raise the same underlying problem or request as reviewer_comment: the same defect, risk or needed change, at the same place or through the same mechanism? Wording may differ. A finding that only touches the same code but raises a different concern does not match; neither does a vague finding that merely mentions the topic.

criteria.true: Same problem or request; acting on agent_finding would address reviewer_comment
criteria.false: Different problem, or too vague to address reviewer_comment
